title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.28591v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain. However, training and inference often rely on costly numerical integration of the learned vector field, typically using sequential Runge-Kutta time stepping, which limits temporal parallelism. We introduce PaPi, an integration scheme inspired by weakly nonlinear flows that enables time-Parallel inference through exponential integration and a Duhamel-Picard scheme. We show that the Duhamel-Picard iteration converges exponentially for all flows, and provide explicit error bounds that depend on how close the flow is to linear. Experiments show that PaPi accelerates training and inference by up to two orders of magnitude, achieving training times of under one second for low-dimensional PDE learning problems, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy.

translated_title: PaPi：面向快速神经谱架构的并行Picard-Duhamel积分方法
translated_abstract: 神经谱架构（NeuSA）是一类物理信息神经网络（PINN），已被证明在频域中求解时间依赖的偏微分方程（PDE）方面非常有效。然而，其训练和推理通常依赖于对学习到的向量场进行代价高昂的数值积分，一般采用顺序执行的Runge-Kutta时间步进方法，这限制了时间上的并行性。我们提出了PaPi，这是一种受弱非线性流启发的积分方案，通过指数积分和Duhamel-Picard方案实现了时间并行推理。我们证明了Duhamel-Picard迭代对所有流均呈指数收敛，并给出了取决于流与线性系统接近程度的显式误差界。实验表明，PaPi可将训练和推理加速多达两个数量级，对于低维PDE学习问题实现了不到一秒的训练时间，同时保持了具有竞争力的预测精度。
tldr: PaPi通过指数积分与Duhamel-Picard方案实现时间并行推理，证明了该迭代对所有流均呈指数收敛并给出显式误差界，从而将神经谱架构的训练与推理加速多达两个数量级，使低维PDE学习问题的训练时间缩短至一秒以内，同时保持有竞争力的预测精度。
en_tdlr: PaPi enables time-parallel inference for neuro-spectral architectures through exponential integration and a Duhamel-Picard scheme, whose iteration converges exponentially with explicit error bounds, accelerating training and inference by up to two orders of magnitude—achieving sub-second training for low-dimensional PDE learning—while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy.
